approval_bridge.mechanism: Manual merge of the PR introducing this record approves these version-scoped dispositions for reconstruction authority work only. Publication remains separately locked.

records.summary: Use Opening and Denouement as the named pre- and post-Movement Action phases.

approval_bridge.effect: Manual merge approved the version-scoped reconstruction dispositions for authority construction only.

semantic_assertions: Turn order contains Opening before Movement and Denouement after Movement.
Phase names alone do not grant additional Actions.

records.summary: Normalize the complete Action/Faction Action/Faction Ability economy separately from the phase-name migration.

semantic_assertions: Exactly two named Action phases exist.
Normal turn Action count and per-phase Action capacity remain distinct permissions.
Directly permitted procedures do not manufacture extra Action phases.

records.summary: Use Onset as the formal battle-opening stage.

approval_bridge.effect: Manual merge approved the version-scoped reconstruction dispositions for authority construction only.

semantic_assertions: Onset is distinct from the turn Opening phase.

records.summary: Treat pending battle, Terms, and Onset as separate procedural states and review the exact boundary independently.

semantic_assertions: Accepted Terms before Onset prevent the battle from beginning.
A pre-Onset withdrawal has no battle result or Aftermath.
Post-Onset withdrawal follows the separately approved no-winner cleanup rule.

additional_recovered_decisions.subject: neutral-armistice
additional_recovered_decisions.rule: Armistice remains a persistent cost-4 Asset, but its two-card upkeep occurs at the start of its controller's Opening rather than after the normal Draw; Draw-suppression effects therefore cannot skip the upkeep.
additional_recovered_decisions.reason: PR #571 canonicalized this v0.6.3 interaction correction after the normalized reconstruction candidate registry was created. It supersedes the earlier post-Draw Armistice timing and was included in the refreshed final v0.6.3 closeout. The rule text intentionally mirrors the canonical governance wording used by the reconstruction validator.

additional_recovered_decisions.subject: neutral-manifest-destiny
additional_recovered_decisions.rule: Whenever Manifest Destiny enters the Gauntlet as a Territory, it is a normal Territory with a normal Deed; existing Deed purchase costs, caps, procedures, income rules, and Controlling Interest rules apply unchanged.
additional_recovered_decisions.reason: PR #571 made the already-intended Deed treatment explicit and regression-guarded for v0.6.3 after the normalized reconstruction candidate registry was created.

additional_recovered_decisions.subject: neutral-contingency-plan
additional_recovered_decisions.rule: Contingency Plan draws one card whenever it is Removed under the defined involuntary Asset Removal event, regardless of cause, and its Gambit/Tactic effect grants +2 Battle Total while the opponent controls more Territories.
additional_recovered_decisions.reason: PR #571 canonicalized both the general Removal trigger and the +2 Battle Total correction for v0.6.3 after the normalized reconstruction candidate registry was created.
